title.fr: Au kilo : một ký, nửa ký
title.en: By the kilo: một ký, nửa ký

body.fr: Au marché, fruits, légumes et viande se vendent au kilo : một ký, nửa ký. Au Nord, on dit plutôt cân. La vendeuse pèse devant toi, souvent sur une petite balance à aiguille, puis annonce le prix. Tu peux aussi acheter les gros fruits à l'unité.
body.en: At the market fruit, vegetables and meat are sold by the kilo: một ký, nửa ký. In the North people say cân. The seller weighs in front of you, often on a small dial scale, then gives the price. Big fruit can also be bought by the piece.
